hooks.name: Auto Push to GitHub
hooks.description: Automatically commits and pushes all changes to GitHub when the agent session ends (Stop trigger), ensuring the remote repo stays in sync with every round of work.

action.command: powershell -Command "Set-Location 'd:\\kiro'; $status = git status --porcelain; if ($status) { git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: auto-sync changes to GitHub'; git push } else { Write-Output 'Nothing to push — working tree clean.' }"
